notes.title: Update: Fixed some bugs in Last Labyrinth.
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that an update was released today and fixed the following issues.
[list]
[*] Applicable stores: Steam
[*] Supported devices: SteamVR compatible PC
[*] Update date: Tuesday, July 24, 2023
[*] Major fixes/updates
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue that the controller instruction image is incorrect.
[*] Fixed an issue that Katia may fall into the pit in the Room of "Strength" under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue that the hatch will fall before Katia walk across it in the Room of "Strength" under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue that Katia will not press the button when holding a weight in the Room of "Justice" under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue that the cut-scenes of game over and game clear are played simultaneously in the Room of "The Lovers" under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue that Katia will move towards the door during chess games under certain conditions.
[*] Other minor improvements.
[/olist]
[/list]

notes.title: Today, The Major Update to Add the Monitor Mode
notes.content:
[h2]The Major Update to Add the Monitor Mode Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost- Applied to the SteamVR Versions on March 22, 2023[/h2]

Today, the major update adding the Monitor Mode Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost- has been applied to the SteamVR version of the game. This update allows players without a VR headset to experience the world of Last Labyrinth on a PC.


[h3]Major Update Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost- Overview[/h3]
[list]
[*] Update Title: Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost-
[*] Target Distribution Stores: Steam
[*] Target Hardware: Equivalent to SteamVR compatible PC (Minimum Requirements: Windows 10(64bit)/ Intel Core™i5 4590/ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or above）
[*] Date of update: March 22nd, 2023
[*] Main Updates
[olist]
[*] Addition of the monitor mode L4.
[*] Addition of a share feature for saving data and trophies between the VR mode Last Labyrinth and the monitor mode L4.
[*] Other partial fixes to the game flow (including fixes to the VR mode Last Labyrinth)
[/olist]
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Bundles of Tokyo Chronos, Last Labyrinth, ALTDEUS, and The Tale of Onogoro
notes.content:
[h2]The Tale of Onogoro and Last Labyrinth, developed by Amata, and the bundle of Tokyo Chronos and ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos, developed by MyDearest, are available today! [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28374/VR

Amata and MyDearest are coming together to collaborate on Steam! These leading Japanese VR game development companies have worked together to deliver the “VR Adventure Bundle” containing four VR adventure game titles (two from each company) on Steam, going on sale today at a special 20% off the price. 
The four titles of [i]Last Labyrinth[/i] and [i]The Tale of Onogoro[/i] from Amata and [i]TOKYO CHRONOS[/i] and [i]ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos[/i] from MyDearest are available to buy at a lower price than if bought individually. For those who have already bought some of the relevant titles, you can still find the others for a special price, so please check them out and enjoy the four titles together.
These four titles are also part of the Steam Autumn Sale 2022, which begins today, so the bundle versions will be available at an even better price during this sale. Don’t miss this great chance!

[h3]◆Overview of Bundled Editions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Product name: VR Adventure Bundle
[*] Bundle contents: "Tokyo Chronos", "Last Labyrinth", "ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos", "The Tale of Onogoro".
[*] Price: 124.96 USD →99.97 USD (20% off)
[*] During the Steam Autumn Sale 2022 (until November 29th, 2022, at 10 am PT), additional discounts will be applied to each title.
[/list]

[h3]About [i]TOKYO CHRONOS[/i][/h3]
An empty, deserted Shibuya where time has frozen over. A suspenseful mystery woven by 8 childhood friends trapped inside.
The future of visual novels, storytelling in VR.
This game will put the player directly in the world of the story.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031440/TOKYO_CHRONOS/

[h3]About [i]Last Labyrinth[/i][/h3]
An escape-the-room adventure game that can only be experienced in VR, Last Labyrinth was
created specifically for the VR age. Players must work to escape a mansion full of hidden
dangers with a mysterious girl that appears before them.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/979400/Last_Labyrinth/

[h3]About [i]ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos[/i][/h3]
ALTDEUS features 15-20 hours of gameplay with one of the largest branching storylines ever in a VR game. Become Chloe, a mecha pilot who will have her revenge and annihilate the Meteora once and for all. Pilot a giant mecha and make the decisions to determine humanity’s future.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502080/ALTDEUS_Beyond_Chronos/

[h3]About [i]The Tale of Onogoro[/i][/h3]
The Tale of Onogoro was created by producer/director Hiromichi Takahashi and the development team behind the VR Escape-the-Room game Last Labyrinth. Last Labyrinth received numerous accolades at game and VR events worldwide due to its unique VR experience. 
The Tale of Onogoro combines traditional Japanese culture and steampunk elements to create its unique world. The Player travels with Haru, a Japanese high priestess, solving sprawling puzzles and battling giant beast-like beings called “Kami” along the way.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023880/_The_Tale_of_Onogoro/

notes.title: The Tale of Onogoro is Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]The SteamVR version of The Tale of Onogoro has finally been released.[/h2]

The Tale of Onogoro, a new VR action-adventure game from the development team behind Last Labyrinth, was available on September 28, 2022.
The Tale of Onogoro original soundtrack is also now available on Steam, including a bundle version with Last Labyrinth.

The SteamVR version of the game features graphic options such as high-resolution rendering, soft-shadow effect enhancements, as well as extra post-processing effects, all of which are aimed at providing gamers with higher-quality experiences according to their PC specifications. 

*Please refer to the Official website "[url=https://onogoro.info/en/howtoplay/]How to Play[/url]" page for more details, along with instructions on how to operate the game with a SteamVR-compatible VR headset.

[h3]◆Overview of the SteamVR version[/h3]
[list]
[*] Title: The Tale of Onogoro 
[*] Genre: VR Action-Adventure Game
[*] Supported HMD: Valve Index, HTC VIVE, HTC VIVE Pro/ Pro2, HTC VIVE Cosmos/ Cosmos Elite, Oculus Rift/ Rift S, Meta Quest/ Quest 2, Windows Mixed Reality Immersive Headset
[*] Supported Hardware: PC fitting the requirements of the above HMDs (Intel® Core i5 7500/ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or above/ OS: Windows 10 (64bit) / Memory: 8GB or more)
[*] *The information has been changed from that published on August 10, 2022. Please be advised.
[*] Number of Players: 1
[*] Online Play: No online play available
[*] Rating: IARC 12+
[*] Price: 34.99 USD (excluding tax, Prices may differ across regions)
[*] Release Date: September 28th, 2022
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023880/_The_Tale_of_Onogoro/

[h3]◆Overview of Soundtrack on Steam[/h3]
[list]
[*] Album Title: The Tale of Onogoro Original Soundtrack
[*] 22 songs including “The Tale of Onogoro” feat. Yumiko Takahashi, “Gondola no Uta” feat. Rekka Katakiri
[*] The content is the same as the original soundtrack already distributed.
[*] Price: 9.99 USD (excluding tax, Prices may differ across regions)
[*] Release date: September 28th, 2022
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2110660/

[h2]Bundle editions with The Tale of Onogoro soundtrack and Last Labyrinth are also available.[/h2]

In conjunction with the release of the SteamVR version of The Tale of Onogoro, a bundle edition with both The Tale of Onogoro and its soundtrack is now available for purchase. At the same time, a different bundle edition that includes the SteamVR version of the VR Escape-the-Room Game, Last Labyrinth, Amata’s first-ever VR game and the companion title of The Tale of Onogoro, has also been released. Bundle editions are available at cheaper prices than if you buy the individual products separately.
 
[h3]◆Overview of The Tale of Onogoro Soundtrack Edition[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bundle contents: The Tale of Onogoro game software, The Tale of Onogoro original soundtrack
[*] Price: 44.98 USD→40.48 USD (10％OFF/ excluding tax)
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27394/The_Tale_of_Onogoro_Soundtrack_Edition/

[h3]◆Overview of The Tale of Onogoro + Last Labyrinth VR Adventure Pack[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bundle contents: The Tale of Onogoro game software, Last Labyrinth game software
[*] Price: 64.98 USD→51.98 USD (20％OFF/ excluding tax)
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27809/The_Tale_of_Onogoro__Last_Labyrinth_VR_Adventure_Pack/
